metadata.description: Tools and slash commands for the Agent Orchestrator. Distributed via this repository — devs add the marketplace with `/plugin marketplace add <git-host>/<owner>/agent-orchestration` and install plugins from it.

plugins.name: agent-orchestrator
plugins.description: Create and queue Agent Orchestrator tasks from any project. Communicates with a running orchestrator over MCP (Model Context Protocol) with OAuth-delegated authentication — no credentials or repo access required on the developer's machine.
